summary:
ITER 177 — Financial Model (Phase 1) full backend + frontend verification. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_iter177_financial_model.py (meta, stateless compute incl. BS-tie-out + DCF + edge-case growth-only, full CRUD with ownership). Frontend: all five review-request UI assertions PASS on mobile viewport 390x844 via https://modal-responsive-fix.preview.emergentagent.com.

BACKEND DETAIL (super@test.com):
  • GET /api/financial-models/meta → default_assumptions present (revenue_by_year=5 entries), units=['absolute','thousands','lakhs','millions','crores'] (first/default='absolute'), currencies includes INR+USD, historical_stages order = ['pre_revenue','3m','6m','9m','1y','2y'] ✓, max_projection_years=10.
  • POST /api/financial-models/compute (default assumptions, 5 yrs): pnl/balance_sheet/cash_flow/ratios/valuation/summary all present; balance_sheet.balance_check[i]≈0 for every year (abs<1.0) — BS ties out; valuation.enterprise_value / equity_value / per_share all numeric; ratios.dscr is a 5-list; summary.revenue_cagr_pct + dscr_avg numeric.
  • Edge case (empty revenue_by_year + year1_revenue=5M + growth=50%): 200; rev[1] ≈ rev[0]*1.5 ✓; BS still ties.
  • CRUD with ownership: created an Org via POST /api/seven-seven/orgs ({name,org_type=BUSINESS,life_area=finance,…}) → 200. Then POST /api/financial-models {user_org_id, assumptions, projection_years:5} → 200 with computed. GET ?user_org_id=… lists it. GET /{id} returns model+computed. PUT {assumptions: gross_margin_pct 55→75} returns recomputed with gross_profit[0] rising AND GET re-confirms persisted GM=75. DELETE → {ok:true}; subsequent GET → 404 ✓.
  • Non-owned org guard: POST /api/financial-models with fake user_org_id → 404 ✓.

FRONTEND DETAIL (mobile 390x844, super@test.com → /admin landing, then deep-links):
  • Login → API-created Org (TEST_iter177 UI Co) → /tools/org-detail?id=<orgId>. The '6 LeGs GOALS' tab is reachable; the 'Financial Model — forecasts · ratios · DCF valuation' button (testID open-financial-model) is present and navigates to /tools/financial-model?org=<orgId> ✓.
  • On the Financial Model screen the Inputs tab prefills every assumption (testIDs fm-gross_margin_pct, fm-wacc_pct, fm-opex_pct, …) and per-year array inputs render for revenue/capex/new_debt/repayment/new_equity. Setting Gross margin %=70 and tapping Recalculate (fm-recalc) refreshes the computed payload without error.
  • Tabs fm-tab-pnl, fm-tab-bs, fm-tab-cf, fm-tab-ratios, fm-tab-valuation all clickable and render their respective views. Valuation tab shows the three coloured cards 'Enterprise Value' / 'Equity Value' / 'Per-Share Price' with actual numeric values (₹54,286,856 / ₹59,286,856 / ₹74.11 in our sample run). Headline indicators (Revenue CAGR 59.67%, Average DSCR 18.53x, Min DSCR 4.49x, Final-year PAT ₹15,451,500) render correctly.
  • Save (fm-save) shows native 'Saved — Financial model created.' alert; follow-up GET /api/financial-models?user_org_id=<orgId> returns 1 model ✓.
  • L1-goal calculator icon: created an L1 goal via /api/six-legs/goals; on /tools/org-detail the testID fm-open-<goalId> renders, taps to /tools/financial-model?org=…&goal=<goalId>, and the screen loads the Inputs assumption fields ✓.
  • /tools/orgs lists the test org by name (visible).

No iter177-introduced regressions. No NEW Expo deprecations beyond the already-tracked chronic warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, TouchableWithoutFeedback, expo-notifications web listener) from iter176.

action_items: (NONE blocking) ITER 177 Financial Model Phase 1 verified end-to-end. Main agent can proceed without rework.
(low / chronic) Continue tracking RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, TouchableWithoutFeedback) for a future cleanup pass.
critical_code_review_comments: core/fin_model.py — clean, side-effect-free pure functions; _series() pads/truncates lists; balance_sheet.balance_check is computed as total_assets - total_liabilities so it ties out by construction since net_worth absorbs retained earnings and cash absorbs the period net change; DCF guards (wacc>tg, wacc>-1) prevent div-by-zero; FCFF uses standard EBIT*(1-tax)+Dep-Capex-ΔWC.

routes/financial_model.py — clean. _own_org() checks owner_user_id; _with_computed() strips _id and wraps compute_model in try/except so a malformed assumption set still returns the stored model with a compute_error string instead of 500; PUT uses an allowed-keys allow-list so a client cannot mutate user_id/user_org_id; DELETE is owner-scoped.

frontend/app/tools/financial-model.tsx — testIDs fm-<key> + fm-tab-<k> + fm-recalc + fm-save all wired; per-array inputs render projection_years × TextInputs; recalc calls /api/financial-models/compute statelessly when no model id exists; save creates+navigates; dirty bar appears when assumptions change on a non-Inputs tab.
frontend/app/tools/org-detail.tsx — open-financial-model button + fm-open-<goalId> calculator icon both router.push to /tools/financial-model?org=<orgId>[&goal=<goalId>] — confirmed wired.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all five review-request UI assertions (org-detail → FM screen → Inputs prefill → Recalculate → all 5 tabs render → Save persists → L1-goal calculator icon navigates)

seed_data_creation: Backend test created an Org+Model and deleted both (Model hard-delete via DELETE /api/financial-models/{id}, Org soft-delete via DELETE /api/seven-seven/orgs/{id}). Frontend test created an Org+Model+L1 goal and cleaned up the L1 goal + Org; the Model created via UI Save (named 'Financial Model') remains under the soft-deleted Org for super@test.com (will be hidden since org.active=false). All TEST_iter177 prefixed for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: POST /api/auth/login returns token under 'session_token' (NOT access_token/token). Org create endpoint is POST /api/seven-seven/orgs with body {name, org_type='BUSINESS', life_area='finance', sub_area?, description?, icon?, color?} and returns {user_org:{id,…}}. Financial-Model endpoints are all under /api/financial-models. Inputs tab key is 'assumptions' (testID fm-tab-assumptions); other tabs are pnl/bs/cf/ratios/valuation. Save button shows a native showAlert popup with 'OK' button — close it before further interaction. The L1-goal calculator icon is fm-open-<goalId>; the main button is open-financial-model. Compute engine is 100% deterministic from assumptions, so BS ties out by construction.
